title_youtube: This Man Ate an Entire Airplane, Piece by Piece
description_youtube:
The man who ate an airplane: Michel Lotito, a French entertainer known as Monsieur Mangetout ("Mr. Eats-All"), cut up a Cessna 150 and swallowed it between 1978 and 1980.

He sawed the metal into bite-size pieces and swallowed them like pills with mineral oil and lots of water. Guinness World Records gave him a brass plaque for the world's strangest diet, and he ate that too. Over his life he also claimed bicycles, shopping carts, TV sets and a coffin. His own doctor told Guinness they never found a valid medical explanation. Snopes points out that nobody ever documented the whole plane bite by bite.

Please don't try this: swallowing metal or glass can be deadly.

Sources:

- Snopes, "Meet Michel Lotito, the Man Who Ate an Entire Airplane... or So He Claimed" (2022): https://www.snopes.com/news/2022/03/07/michel-lotito-ate-entire-airplane/
